cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've sat cross-legged on the floor, so I've sat down too. Are we having breakfast without the table now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm doing yoga. There's room since the table moved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, flexibility. Did making this room involve you moving the table?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I put it in the hall. I've moved the breakfast things somewhere easier too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. Are those the bowls on the windowsill, or has someone else been making space as well?
